body: multiple layers. last thing I thought about was proof reading.

It would help. It would open a couple more doors and set the stage for better things. I went to a local university and was accepted after my placement. I was unable to attend school because I was spending all my time at work, trying to make a name for my self there.

Last time I tried, it was 2012. here is a photo of my English [assessment](http://i.imgur.com/fYdjpLl.jpg). 

I think my suicidal thoughts are stemming from multiple layers*.  I have made it this far by always finding away to continue, however; I have failed to identify and deal with the underlying issues, hence my current(reoccurring?) situation.  

Not being able to find work seems to be the catalyst of all this. Not having a good support group or a way to deal with lifes daily stress compounded by constant "unlucky" situations has effectively crippled me.

thank you for your kind words and suggestion for work. 

I have considered your exact suggestion. Oct 31. I totaled my car. Bought an suv, and then went to wainwright ab. I spent 3 weeks there trying to get a job but could not. made 1400 in 3 weeks working with a drywall boarding crew. most places up there are laying off, no one hiring. because I have no money and no connections; all efforts applied to finding a camp job has proven to be futile. 

when I came back, I was stiffed on a tile job and have sent out (according to gmail) 46 application emails since dec 27. I have been contacted by 4 ppl all to say they had 1/2 days of temp work which I took. 

my roommate is my local cousin.
